'''Mroc''' was a [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] [[Nociv]] at the time of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] attempt to conquer [[Kadril]] in [[1 ABY]].

==Biography==
Mroc was an older [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillian]] of a [[Nociv]] village of which also [[Deerna]] was a member. [[Rodno]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], warned the Nocivs for an ongoing attack by [[Stormtrooper]] s with [[Pacifog]]. [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] wanted to collect all [[Kunda]] on Kadril and these stocks were located in the Nociv area.

After the death of [[Mdel]], Mroc became one of the leaders of the Nociv.
